title: Masses of apples
stem: The masses of apples from an orchard are normally distributed with mean 150 g and standard deviation 12 g. Apples heavier than 165 g are graded "large".

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that a randomly chosen apple is large.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Apples lighter than 130 g are rejected. Find the percentage of apples rejected.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: 90% of apples have a mass greater than m grams. Find m.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: A box contains 20 apples chosen at random. Find the probability that at least 3 of them are large.
parts.notes: Use the unrounded probability from (a); 0.106 gives 0.356, which is also accepted.

parts.label: e
parts.prompt: State one assumption needed for the model in part (d).
markscheme: the masses of apples in the box are independent / apples are chosen at random from a large population so p is constant
